name: devboard-harness-ui
description: Reusable UI primitives of the devboard harness interface: a dense, dark-first operator console. All components read their colors, radii, and type from the custom properties documented in DESIGN.md.

Button.description: The single button primitive used across every workspace. It renders a native <button type="button"> and forwards any native attribute (disabled, title, aria-*, data-*, onclick) to it. variant=default is a filled primary action and must appear at most once per surface; secondary is the default; outline and ghost are low-emphasis; destructive is for irreversible actions; link is an inline text action. Focus is a 2px ring with 1px offset; disabled is 45% opacity and non-interactive. Source: .devboard/client/lib/components/ui/button.svelte.
Button.example:
<script>
  import { Button } from "./lib/components/ui/button.svelte";
</script>

<Button variant="default" onclick={() => save()}>Save</Button>
<Button variant="destructive" disabled>Delete record</Button>
<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">Cancel</Button>

variant.description: Visual emphasis. default is the filled primary action; secondary is the default resting style.

size.description: Control height. default is 28px, sm is 24px with 11px type, icon is a 28px square.

class.description: Extra classes merged after the variant classes through the project's cn() helper. Use for layout only, never to override color or radius.

children.description: Visible button label or icon. Required for an accessible name unless aria-label is passed.

disabled.description: Native disabled attribute; renders at 45% opacity and removes pointer events.

type.description: Native button type. Overrides the rendered default.

onclick.description: Click handler receiving the native MouseEvent.

IconButton.description: Square 28px ghost icon button with a required accessible label and a bits-ui tooltip. It applies aria-label and title from label, aria-pressed from active, and data-command from command. Pass an SVG icon as children; it is decorative because label carries the accessible name. Source: .devboard/client/lib/components/ui/icon-button.svelte.
IconButton.example:
<script>
  import IconButton from "./lib/components/ui/icon-button.svelte";
  import { RefreshCw } from "lucide-svelte";
</script>

<IconButton label="Refresh" command="refresh" onclick={() => reload()}>
  <RefreshCw size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
</IconButton>

label.description: Accessible name and tooltip text. Required.

command.description: Command identifier written to data-command for the command palette.

data-testid.description: Test hook forwarded to the trigger element.

active.description: Renders the active fill and sets aria-pressed to true.

class.description: Extra classes merged after the ghost icon-button classes.

onclick.description: Click handler receiving the native MouseEvent.

children.description: The icon; rendered inside the trigger. Required.

Input.description: Text input primitive: 28px tall, background fill, strong border, 4px radius, ring on focus, muted placeholder. It renders a native <input> and forwards every native attribute except class (type, value, placeholder, disabled, oninput, aria-*, data-*), so it carries no component-level defaults. Source: .devboard/client/lib/components/ui/input.svelte.
Input.example:
<script>
  import Input from "./lib/components/ui/input.svelte";
  let query = $state("");
</script>

<Input type="search" placeholder="Filter goals" bind:value={query} aria-label="Filter goals" />

class.description: Extra classes merged after the base input classes.

type.description: Native input type; passed through with no component default.

disabled.description: Native disabled attribute; renders at 50% opacity.

PageHeader.description: Page identity block shared by every workspace page: an optional overline eyebrow, one h1 title, an optional subtitle, an optional meta row, a right-aligned action group, and an optional footer band. layout=bar is the one-row operational variant; below a 300px identity floor the state/action cluster wraps under the identity so the page name never truncates. footer adds a full-width secondary band under a hairline for controls that configure the primary action. Actions must contain at most one filled primary. Source: .devboard/client/lib/components/ui/page-header.svelte.
PageHeader.example: {#snippet meta()}draft{/snippet} {#snippet actions()}{/snippet} {#snippet footer()}{/snippet}

eyebrow.description: Uppercase overline above the title, 10px label type in muted-foreground.

title.description: The page h1. 20px page-title type; truncates with a title tooltip and never wraps to a second line.

subtitle.description: One-sentence page purpose or state, 12px body-small in muted-foreground.

meta.description: Optional inline meta row: status badges, counts, a file path. Wraps at 4px row and 12px column gaps.

actions.description: Right-aligned action group. At most one filled primary action per page; secondary and outline follow.

footer.description: Optional secondary band under the identity/action row, separated by a 1px border-subtle hairline and padded 6px 12px. Holds controls that configure the page's primary action. It spans the header's full width; its groups wrap as units.

layout.description: stacked keeps identity, meta, and actions on their own lines. bar puts identity, meta, and actions on one operational row (8px 12px padding, 16px gap); a 300px identity floor moves the meta/action cluster below the identity instead of truncating the page name.

flat.description: Removes the surface fill, border, radius, and padding so a parent panel owns the frame.

testid.description: Value for data-testid on the header element.

StageTrack.description: Five-stage lifecycle position for Goal mode: Goal, Epics, ADRs, Implementation, Finished. It marks the current stage with aria-current="step", marks earlier stages complete, and prints the pass, a state word (Not started, Running, Paused, Finished, Manual run), and the work item. It never infers progress the server did not report; seen=false always renders the Goal stage as current. Source: .devboard/client/lib/components/ui/stage-track.svelte.
StageTrack.example:
<script>
  import StageTrack from "./lib/components/ui/stage-track.svelte";
</script>

<StageTrack stage="adr" pass={2} paused={false} seen workLabel="0003-ledger-schema.md" workUrl={null} />

stage.description: Current lifecycle stage from the server.

pass.description: Lifecycle pass number, printed only after the lifecycle reports a stage other than Goal.

paused.description: Whether the lifecycle is paused; renders the Paused state word.

seen.description: False until the server reports a stage other than Goal. Suppresses the pass and states Not started.

workLabel.description: The epic or ADR currently processed, or a manual run title. Rendered as text or a link.

workUrl.description: Upstream epic URL for workLabel; null renders plain text.

manual.description: A single-record run outside the lifecycle. Changes the state word and the work verb.

testid.description: Value for data-testid on the track root.
